elnaz/1.jpg.description: A breathtaking view from an airplane window during sunset, showcasing the wing and engine of the aircraft against a vibrant sky filled with orange and golden hues. Below, fluffy white clouds stretch across the horizon, illuminated by the setting sun, creating a serene and majestic scene.

elnaz/10.jpg.description: A romantic couple embraces on a beach at twilight, with a beautifully set table for two nearby, illuminated by torches and overlooking the ocean. The scene exudes intimacy and tranquility, perfect for a memorable evening.

elnaz/100.jpg.description: An ornate, classical building with intricate stone carvings and arched windows, viewed from an elevated perspective. The structure features detailed architectural elements and is situated near a river with boats visible in the background. The scene appears to be in a European city, likely Paris, under an overcast sky.

elnaz/101.jpg.description: Three pairs of Puma sneakers displayed on shelves, each in a different colorway: brown with white accents, pink with white accents, and black with pink accents. All feature the iconic Puma branding and design.

elnaz/102.jpg.description: A grand, fairytale-style castle with multiple spires and red-tiled roofs stands majestically under a partly cloudy sky. In the foreground, an ornate fountain with a sculpted figure adds to the magical ambiance, while visitors stroll along the pathways. The scene is set in a theme park, with decorative lampposts and manicured greenery enhancing the enchanting atmosphere.

elnaz/103.jpg.description: A person with long brown hair, dressed in a black and white outfit with a bow at the back, stands in an opulent room adorned with golden ornate frames and classical paintings. The setting appears to be a grand gallery or palace hall with intricate wall decorations and polished wooden floors.

elnaz/104.jpg.description: A couple takes a selfie in a theme park or shopping mall, both wearing playful plush headbands. The woman has a panda headband with a yellow hat, while the man holds a large pink plush unicorn. In the background, there are decorations and signage for 'Shrek' and 'The Hidden World', suggesting a DreamWorks-themed area. The atmosphere is lively and festive, with other visitors around them.

elnaz/105.jpg.description: A man poses confidently with his hands on the hood of a classic white 1958 Chevrolet, which features a California license plate. The setting appears to be an amusement park or themed area, indicated by the large green canopy, manicured topiary trees, and a visible 'Despicable Me' promotional sign with Minion characters in the background. Other visitors are seen nearby, contributing to the lively atmosphere.

elnaz/106.jpg.description: A woman stands elegantly in a grand, ornate gallery adorned with golden frames and intricate decorations. She is dressed in a chic black and white outfit, with her arms crossed and a thoughtful expression as she gazes upward, surrounded by classical art and luxurious architectural details.

elnaz/107.jpg.description: A slice of pizza served on a white triangular plate, featuring melted cheese, cherry tomatoes, and pieces of ham. Accompanying the pizza are two packets of Heinz chilli sauce. The setting appears to be a dining area with a blue placemat that includes branding for 'Resorts World Sentosa Singapore'.

elnaz/108.jpg.description: A woman stands on a street in front of a building with classic architecture, holding a large pink plush unicorn. She is smiling and dressed casually in a black top and white shorts. American flags are visible on the building, and a large banner on the wall reads 'STUDIOS' and 'FELLER CENTER'.

elnaz/109.jpg.description: An outdoor seating area of a retro-style diner with turquoise walls and glass block windows. Neon signs in red advertise 'Fries', 'Shakes', and 'Burgers'. Metal chairs and tables are arranged on a speckled floor, with reflections of the interior visible in the glass. A few patrons are seated inside, and the scene has a vibrant, nostalgic ambiance.

elnaz/11.jpg.description: A lavishly decorated Christmas dinner table set for celebration, featuring a white tablecloth, ornate silverware, a chocolate cake with white icing, and a centerpiece of red candles and greenery. A large, illuminated white Christmas tree stands in the background, flanked by elegant curtains. The room is adorned with a chandelier and festive food arrangements, creating a warm and luxurious holiday atmosphere.

elnaz/110.jpg.description: A framed painting of the Mona Lisa, depicting her iconic enigmatic smile and serene expression, set against a softly blurred landscape. The artwork is encased in an ornate, gilded frame with intricate detailing, enhancing its classical and timeless appeal.

elnaz/111.jpg.description: A woman poses on a street in front of a building with 'NBC Studios Rockefeller Center' signage, holding a large pink stuffed unicorn and shielding her eyes from the sun. The setting includes American flags and classic architecture, with other visitors nearby.

elnaz/112.jpg.description: A vibrant, rain-soaked street in a bustling urban area, likely in South Korea, lined with brightly lit neon signs in Korean and English. Pedestrians with umbrellas navigate the wet pavement, while storefronts display colorful advertisements for restaurants, shops, and entertainment venues. The scene is lively and saturated with commercial energy under an overcast sky.

elnaz/113.jpg.description: A woman takes a selfie in a dimly lit restaurant, wearing a black top and red lipstick, with a white fur stole draped over her shoulders. She is seated at a table with other guests in the background, including two men. The setting appears elegant, with gold-trimmed chairs and candlesticks, suggesting a formal or celebratory occasion.

elnaz/114.jpg.description: A vibrant bouquet of flowers, including roses, gerbera daisies, and bird of paradise, is elegantly arranged in a white box with a red heart design, placed on a white table near a window with a panoramic view of a cityscape featuring modern buildings and autumn-colored trees. The scene is bright and inviting, suggesting a thoughtful gift or a moment of quiet appreciation.

elnaz/115.jpg.description: A first-person view of a person standing on a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, which is engraved with the name 'GENE KELLY'. The star is embedded in a speckled pavement, and the person's white sneakers are visible at the bottom of the frame.

elnaz/116.jpg.description: A woman in a white fluffy coat smiles at the camera, standing in front of a brightly lit, golden structure resembling the Eiffel Tower at night. Bare trees frame the scene, and the warm glow of the lights contrasts with the dark sky. She wears bold red lipstick and gold hoop earrings, adding to the glamorous and festive atmosphere.

elnaz/117.jpg.description: A cozy tea setting at a fine dining establishment, featuring a silver teapot, cups of hot chocolate, a dessert topped with whipped cream, and a plate of biscuits, all arranged on a white tablecloth with a menu from 'Café Carette' visible.

elnaz/118.jpg.description: A white plate filled with freshly cut pineapple chunks, arranged neatly on a white cloth surface.

elnaz/119.jpg.description: A close-up of a golden-brown crème brûlée in a white ceramic ramekin, placed on a white plate with a blue rim. The dessert has a caramelized sugar crust with some darker, slightly burnt spots. The setting appears to be a dining table with a white tablecloth, and another dessert is partially visible in the background. A spoon rests nearby, suggesting readiness to serve.

elnaz/12.jpg.description: A hand holds a tall, spiral-shaped fried snack, likely a potato or corn snack, against the backdrop of a European-style canal with arched bridges and buildings. The scene suggests a tourist attraction with people walking along the waterway, and the bright turquoise water reflects the surrounding architecture.

elnaz/120.jpg.description: A woman poses gracefully in front of a grand, fairytale-style castle with multiple turrets and red roofs, standing beside a circular fountain adorned with a golden crown sculpture. The scene is set in a well-maintained garden with manicured hedges and blue-and-gold decorative canopies, under a partly cloudy sky.

elnaz/121.jpg.description: A woman stands in the middle of a bustling theme park street, posing with her eyes closed and a relaxed expression. She is dressed in a black top and white shorts, carrying a white crossbody bag. The background features a large theater with showtimes displayed, a glass-roofed walkway, and various colorful decorations including a Minion character. The setting appears to be Universal Studios, with visitors walking around and enjoying the attractions under a partly cloudy sky.

elnaz/122.jpg.description: A collection of perfume bottles arranged on a clear acrylic shelf, featuring various brands including Victoria's Secret, Miss Dior, Chanel, and Ariana Grande. The bottles display a range of shapes, sizes, and colors, predominantly in soft pink and clear glass, with some featuring decorative elements like a heart-shaped bottle and a high-heeled shoe-shaped bottle. The arrangement suggests a personal vanity or fragrance collection display.

elnaz/123.jpg.description: A nighttime view of the Eiffel Tower, illuminated with golden lights, captured with a motion blur effect that creates streaks of light and movement around the structure. The sky is hazy, and the base of the tower shows blurred lights and figures, suggesting a bustling urban environment.

elnaz/124.jpg.description: A marble sculpture of a youthful figure, likely a putto or cherub, depicted with curly hair and a serene expression, holding a vessel above their head. The figure is nude, with detailed anatomical features and a smooth, polished finish. The sculpture appears to be part of a larger architectural or decorative ensemble, possibly in a museum setting, as suggested by the visible signage in the background.

elnaz/125.jpg.description: An ornate museum hall with classical architecture, featuring grand columns and intricate capitals. At the center, a prominent statue of a draped female figure stands between two dark columns, positioned above a large marble bathtub. Surrounding sculptures and artifacts are displayed on pedestals, creating a grand and historic ambiance.

elnaz/126.jpg.description: A nighttime walkway lined with tall palm trees, illuminated by soft lights at their bases, creating a serene and tropical atmosphere. People stroll along the path, with modern architecture visible in the background, suggesting an urban park or waterfront promenade.

elnaz/127.jpg.description: A nighttime scene featuring tall palm trees with illuminated green fronds, set against a dark sky. The trees are densely packed, creating a tropical canopy. In the background, modern city buildings with lit windows and a waterfront area are visible, suggesting an urban park or promenade. A few people can be seen walking among the trees, adding a sense of scale and life to the scene.

elnaz/128.jpg.description: A person wearing a white fluffy coat holds a light green Ladurée pastry bag, which features the brand's logo and text 'Maison fondée en 1862' and 'Paris'. The setting appears to be indoors with tiled flooring and a reflection of a car visible in the background.

elnaz/129.jpg.description: A woman in a white fluffy coat smiles at the camera while standing in front of the Louvre Museum at night. The iconic glass pyramid is illuminated in the background, contrasting with the historic stone architecture. She is posing near a metal barricade, with the warm glow of the museum lights creating a cozy and elegant atmosphere.

elnaz/13.jpg.description: A close-up of a digital display showing handwritten mathematical problems and formulas, including trigonometric identities and calculations, with a website URL at the bottom.

elnaz/130.jpg.description: A woman poses elegantly on a waterfront promenade at night, with a stunning cityscape of illuminated skyscrapers and a distinctive glass building featuring a 'V' logo in the background. She is dressed in a navy blue top and white shorts, accessorized with a small white handbag and a delicate necklace, capturing the vibrant urban nightlife ambiance.

elnaz/131.jpg.description: A woman in a white fluffy coat smiles warmly while posing on a high vantage point overlooking a city at night. The iconic Eiffel Tower is visible in the distance, illuminated against the dark sky, with the city lights creating a vibrant and romantic backdrop.

elnaz/132.jpg.description: A classical marble statue of a winged figure, likely an angel or deity, with detailed curly hair and a serene expression. The sculpture is nude, showcasing muscular definition and graceful posture, with one arm raised and the other extended. The setting appears to be an ornate interior with decorative architectural elements and a stained-glass window in the background.

elnaz/133.jpg.description: A woman in a white fur coat holds a black folding fan in front of her face, partially obscuring it. She has long dark hair and is posing indoors, with a mirror and another person visible in the background. The fan has a semi-transparent, striped pattern, and her hands are adorned with light pink nail polish and a ring.

elnaz/134.jpg.description: A woman with a warm smile and red lipstick is seated in a cozy, vibrant bar with pink neon lights and a festive atmosphere. She is wearing a beige zip-up sweater and has her hands clasped near her chest. The background features a well-stocked bar, red upholstered seating, and other patrons enjoying the lively setting, suggesting a social gathering or celebration.

elnaz/135.jpg.description: A plate of golden-brown french fries served with a green sauce, placed on a white tablecloth with a yellow napkin and a wine glass nearby.

elnaz/136.jpg.description: The image showcases the ancient Temple of Antoninus and Faustina in Rome, featuring its iconic Corinthian columns and classical architecture under a clear blue sky. The structure, with its weathered stone and remnants of its original design, stands as a testament to Roman engineering and artistry, surrounded by greenery and set against a backdrop of modern urban elements.

elnaz/137.jpg.description: A breathtaking view of an ornate ceiling fresco in a grand Baroque-style church, featuring dynamic scenes of mythological and religious figures amidst swirling clouds and architectural elements. The intricate details, vibrant colors, and dramatic composition convey a sense of divine grandeur and artistic mastery.

elnaz/138.jpg.description: A close-up shot of a plate of pasta, likely fettuccine or a similar noodle, coated in a rich tomato sauce and garnished with fresh green herbs. The plate is light brown with black lettering that reads 'DA FORTUNATA' and 'BONA - MIAMI'. The setting appears to be a casual dining environment with a yellowish table surface and a white napkin nearby.

elnaz/139.jpg.description: The image showcases the iconic Pantheon in Rome, Italy, with its grand classical architecture featuring prominent Corinthian columns supporting an entablature. The massive dome, partially visible on the left, is a hallmark of ancient Roman engineering. Visitors are seen exploring the site, and the sky above is partly cloudy, adding to the historic ambiance of the scene.

elnaz/14.png.description: A surfer rides a wave with arms outstretched, balancing on a surfboard in the ocean under a partly cloudy sky. The scene captures the dynamic motion of surfing with splashing water and a clear blue backdrop.

elnaz/140.jpg.description: A festive night scene at a grand architectural landmark, featuring a large, illuminated spiral sculpture with a star on top, set against the backdrop of a white classical building with columns and arched windows. The area is bustling with people gathered on steps and balconies, illuminated by warm streetlights, creating a magical and celebratory atmosphere.

elnaz/141.jpg.description: A charming cobblestone street in a historic Italian town, lined with colorful flower pots and quaint shops. The iconic Leaning Tower of Pisa is visible in the distance, framed by lush greenery and vibrant blooms. The scene exudes a romantic, picturesque atmosphere, perfect for a leisurely stroll.

elnaz/142.jpg.description: An ancient Roman arch stands majestically against a bright blue sky with scattered clouds. The structure, made of weathered stone, features intricate carvings and inscriptions, including a prominent Latin inscription at the top. The arch is flanked by classical columns and adorned with detailed reliefs, showcasing its historical significance. Trees partially frame the scene, adding a touch of nature to the monumental architecture.

elnaz/143.jpg.description: An upward view of an ornate, baroque-style ceiling fresco in a grand cathedral, featuring dynamic scenes of angels, saints, and mythological figures amidst swirling clouds and golden accents, framed by intricate architectural details and classical columns.

elnaz/144.jpg.description: A grand, ornate interior of a shopping mall adorned with elaborate decorations. A central, towering sculpture with intricate, swirling designs is illuminated with colorful lights. The ceiling features a high, arched glass structure with a deep blue hue, embellished with hanging lights and decorative elements resembling fireworks. Multiple levels of balconies and arches surround the space, with visible storefronts and shoppers below, creating a festive and luxurious atmosphere.

elnaz/145.jpg.description: A close-up of a white plate featuring a seafood dish with grilled shrimp and mussels, showcasing their cooked and slightly charred appearance.

elnaz/146.jpg.description: A beautifully set table for a gathering, featuring an array of appetizers and desserts. The spread includes plates of cherry tomatoes and mozzarella, assorted macarons, salmon-topped bread rounds, grilled pear slices with cheese, and various bite-sized snacks. The table is adorned with elegant blue and white patterned plates, gold-rimmed glassware, and silver cutlery, creating a sophisticated and festive atmosphere.

elnaz/147.jpg.description: A serene poolside scene at a resort with a young girl in a swimsuit sitting by the pool, surrounded by lounge chairs and a closed green-and-white striped umbrella. Palm trees frame the view, and a modern building with outdoor seating is visible in the background under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.

elnaz/148.jpg.description: A woman smiles brightly in a nighttime cityscape, wearing a white top and denim jacket, with a modern skyscraper illuminated in the background. The photo is taken from a low angle, emphasizing the urban setting and the subject's joyful expression.

elnaz/149.jpg.description: A woman is standing in a luxurious shopping mall, surrounded by festive decorations and holding multiple designer shopping bags from brands like Louis Vuitton, Fendi, and Cartier. She is smiling and appears to be enjoying her shopping experience, with golden lights and holiday ornaments enhancing the festive atmosphere.

elnaz/15.jpg.description: A woman stands on a sandy beach beside a large, textured rock formation, with the ocean visible in the background. She is wearing a white outfit and has a flower in her hair, smiling at the camera. The scene is bright and natural, with clear skies and scattered seaweed on the sand.

elnaz/150.jpg.description: A serene garden pathway lined with tall palm trees and lush greenery, leading towards a distant white building under a clear blue sky. A person is walking along the path, adding a sense of scale and tranquility to the scene.

elnaz/151.jpg.description: A picturesque cobblestone street framed by vibrant pink bougainvillea flowers, leading towards a stunning coastal view with turquoise waters and steep cliffs. Traditional buildings line both sides, adorned with balconies and potted plants, creating a charming Mediterranean scene.

elnaz/152.jpg.description: A breakfast spread featuring three small appetizers on glass plates, including a fried item with sauce, a smoked salmon and cream cheese bite, and a salmon roll with a white center, accompanied by a glass of orange juice, all arranged on a woven placemat with a yellow napkin.

elnaz/153.jpg.description: A woman in a fitness studio is taking a mirror selfie while seated on a Pilates reformer machine. She is wearing a black sports bra and leggings, with white slippers placed on the wooden floor nearby. The studio is equipped with multiple Pilates machines, and the background features a row of windows and bright overhead lighting.

elnaz/154.jpg.description: A woman is smiling while holding multiple shopping bags from luxury brands like Louis Vuitton and Fendi in a brightly lit shopping mall. Behind her, a large golden decorative installation with the text 'AMERICAN RACETE' is visible, adding to the festive atmosphere. The image is taken from an overhead perspective, capturing the vibrant and joyful shopping experience.

elnaz/155.jpg.description: A woman stands in a luxurious shopping mall, surrounded by festive golden lights and holding multiple designer shopping bags from brands like Louis Vuitton and Cartier. She is dressed in a white top and blue jeans, with her hair neatly styled, and the background features high-end retail stores including Van Cleef & Arpels and Dior, creating a glamorous and celebratory atmosphere.

elnaz/156.jpg.description: A couple poses on a Parisian street with the Eiffel Tower in the background. The woman, dressed in a white wedding dress with a veil, holds hands with the man, who is wearing a white t-shirt and black pants. The scene is framed by classic Parisian buildings and parked cars, capturing a romantic and iconic moment.

elnaz/157.jpg.description: A couple walks hand in hand down a Parisian street, with the Eiffel Tower visible in the distance. The bride wears a white wedding dress and veil, while the groom is dressed casually in a white t-shirt and dark pants. The scene is framed by classic Parisian buildings and parked cars, capturing a romantic moment in the city.

elnaz/158.jpg.description: A vibrant bouquet of flowers arranged in a clear glass vase, featuring deep purple chrysanthemums, pink carnations, white blooms, and delicate yellow accents. The arrangement is complemented by green foliage and a red card with handwritten text, set against a backdrop of white curtains.

elnaz/159.jpg.description: A white drawer filled with an assortment of luxury makeup products from brands like Dior, Chanel, Gucci, and others, including foundations, eyeshadows, lipsticks, and brushes, arranged neatly for easy access.

elnaz/16.jpg.description: A group of young people, mostly women, are posing together for a photo inside a modern theater with tiered seating. They are arranged in multiple rows, smiling and making playful gestures. The theater has warm lighting and wooden paneling, creating an inviting atmosphere. Some individuals are sitting on the floor, while others are seated on the theater seats in the background.

elnaz/160.jpg.description: A couple poses in front of an ornate wooden door. The woman, dressed in a white wedding gown with a flowing veil, stands beside the man, who is wearing a white t-shirt and black pants. They appear to be in a romantic or celebratory setting, possibly for a wedding or engagement photoshoot. The background features classical architecture with detailed stonework and a dark wooden door with brass handles.

elnaz/161.jpg.description: A person is holding a vibrant bouquet of flowers, featuring pink and orange tulips, red roses, and a cluster of white daisies with yellow centers. The bouquet is wrapped in brown paper and is held alongside a light blue handbag with a gold chain strap. The person is dressed in a light blue shirt and a beige jacket, standing on a paved sidewalk with part of a vehicle visible in the background.

elnaz/162.jpg.description: A couple walks down a Parisian street, with the Eiffel Tower visible in the background. The woman is wearing a white dress and veil, suggesting a bridal or engagement theme, while the man is dressed casually in a white t-shirt and dark pants. The scene is framed by classic Parisian architecture, with parked cars lining the street, creating a romantic and picturesque urban setting.

elnaz/163.jpg.description: A bride in a white dress and veil stands in the middle of a Parisian street, with the Eiffel Tower visible in the background. The scene is framed by tall buildings on either side, with cars parked along the road. The lighting is soft and diffused, creating a romantic and elegant atmosphere.

elnaz/164.jpg.description: A couple poses affectionately in front of an ornate wooden door. The woman, dressed in a white dress with a veil and white heels, wraps her arms around the man from behind, smiling upward. The man, wearing a white t-shirt and dark pants, stands with his hands in his pockets, looking forward. The setting appears to be an elegant building entrance, with the number '2' visible on the wall beside the door.

elnaz/165.jpg.description: A couple walks down a narrow Parisian street, with the Eiffel Tower visible in the background. The man, dressed in a white t-shirt and black pants, gestures toward the tower, while the woman beside him, wearing a white dress, looks up at it with a smile. The scene is framed by historic buildings and parked cars, capturing a romantic moment in the city.

elnaz/166.png.description: A hand gently touches a large, beautifully arranged bouquet of soft pink and cream-colored roses wrapped in brown paper and tied with a beige ribbon that reads 'CÉLINE FLORAL'. A handwritten note attached to the bouquet reads, 'Will you be my partner? For AIB &'. The setting appears to be a modern, minimalist room with white chairs and a light-colored table, suggesting a romantic or celebratory occasion.

elnaz/167.jpg.description: A breathtaking view of an ornate ceiling fresco, showcasing a dynamic and intricate scene filled with numerous mythological or religious figures in motion, set against a backdrop of classical architecture with columns and decorative moldings. The painting is rich in detail, with vibrant colors and dramatic lighting that create a sense of grandeur and divine presence. The perspective suggests the interior of a grand cathedral or palace, with elaborate stucco work and gilded accents enhancing the opulence of the space.

elnaz/168.jpg.description: A person wearing a white fluffy coat and a glittery bow headband poses for a selfie in front of a pink and blue castle with golden spires, under a partly cloudy sky. The setting appears to be a theme park, with manicured gardens and other visitors in the background.

elnaz/169.jpg.description: The image showcases the ancient Temple of Antoninus and Faustina in Rome, featuring its iconic Corinthian columns and classical architecture. The structure stands against a clear blue sky, with sunlight highlighting the weathered stone and intricate details. The temple's remnants, including its partially intact entablature and brick foundations, evoke a sense of historical grandeur and enduring legacy.

elnaz/17.jpg.description: A beautifully arranged bouquet featuring a mix of pink roses and white chrysanthemums, accented with green eucalyptus leaves. The bouquet is held by someone wearing brown pants and is tied with a light pink ribbon that has the word 'BULVARI' printed on it. The setting appears to be indoors on a wooden floor.

elnaz/170.jpg.description: A view from within the ancient ruins of the Colosseum in Rome, looking out through a weathered archway. The scene captures a bright, partly cloudy sky above a lush green park with iconic Italian cypress trees. Visitors can be seen walking along pathways below, emphasizing the historical grandeur and enduring beauty of the site.

elnaz/171.jpg.description: A family of three, dressed in black, stands together under an ornate archway, holding hands. A luxury car is parked nearby, and the setting appears to be a grand, sunlit terrace with classical architecture and potted plants.

elnaz/172.jpg.description: A view framed by an ancient stone archway, looking out onto a historic Roman ruin landscape under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds. In the distance, classical columns and a partially intact building with a dome are visible, surrounded by greenery and pathways with visitors. The foreground features a metal railing and the textured, weathered stone of the arch.

elnaz/173.jpg.description: A person wearing a white fluffy coat and a glittery gold bow headband poses cheerfully in front of the iconic pink castle at Disneyland Paris, with a cloudy sky overhead.

elnaz/174.jpg.description: A wide-angle view of the Arch of Constantine in Rome, partially covered in scaffolding, set against a bright blue sky with scattered clouds. The historic monument is surrounded by a cobblestone plaza bustling with tourists, with trees and ancient ruins visible in the background.

elnaz/175.jpg.description: A detailed tapestry depicting the scene from Disney's 'Sleeping Beauty,' featuring Maleficent holding her staff as she casts a spell on Princess Aurora. The tapestry is framed with ornate designs including roses and thorns, set against a dark background with stone walls surrounding it.

elnaz/176.jpg.description: A low-angle shot captures the majestic Colonna dell'Imperatore in Rome, with its intricately carved surface rising against a vibrant blue sky. To its left, the grand dome of a classical church, adorned with statues and ornate details, dominates the scene. The sunlight highlights the textures of both ancient monuments, while a few visitors and urban elements frame the historic setting.

elnaz/177.jpg.description: A woman in a white fluffy coat and a glittering gold bow headband smiles gently while posing in front of a pink and blue castle with golden spires, likely at a Disney theme park. The sky is overcast, and the scene is festive and magical.

elnaz/178.jpg.description: A woman in a white, flowing dress with lace detailing is seated on a wet sandy beach, her hand gently touching her face. She wears red lipstick and a gold earring, with a rocky seawall visible to her right. The image is captured from an overhead perspective, emphasizing the serene and contemplative mood.

elnaz/179.jpg.description: A woman in a white dress and gold accessories smiles at the camera while standing near a white railing with a view of greenery outside. She wears a delicate headpiece and has long, wavy brown hair. The setting appears to be a bright, elegant indoor space with large windows and classical architectural details.

elnaz/18.jpg.description: A dancer in traditional attire performs gracefully on stage, wearing a red and white costume with intricate embroidery and a headpiece, illuminated by blue stage lighting against a dark background.

elnaz/180.png.description: A small decorated Christmas tree with a red ribbon stands on a white table next to a plush toy resembling a lion cub. Beside the tree is a pink bulb with green shoots and a card with floral designs. A silver watch lies on the table, and the scene is set against a plain gray wall.

elnaz/181.jpg.description: A couple in matching striped pajamas embraces warmly in a cozy, well-decorated room. The woman, with her hair in a ponytail, rests her head on the man's shoulder, while he holds her close. A lit candle and neatly arranged shelves with books and decor create a serene, intimate atmosphere.

elnaz/182.jpg.description: A woman in a gym, wearing black boxing gloves and athletic attire, takes a selfie in front of a mirror. The setting features modern blue and yellow lighting, with other people visible in the background. She holds a white smartphone with a blue wristband attached.

elnaz/183.jpg.description: A woman in a gym, wearing black boxing gloves and athletic attire, takes a selfie in front of a mirror. The modern gym features blue and white decor with glass partitions and other people working out in the background.

elnaz/184.jpg.description: A single white frangipani flower with a yellow center rests gently on a sandy beach, surrounded by fine grains and small shell fragments.

elnaz/185.jpg.description: A close-up shot of a person wearing black Everlast boxing gloves, positioned with fists raised in a fighting stance. The gloves feature white and yellow branding, and the background is a textured gray surface. A portion of a black and white sneaker is visible in the lower left corner.

elnaz/186.jpg.description: A woman poses playfully with her lips puckered in front of a grand architectural landmark, likely a cathedral or church, set in a lush green park with manicured hedges and pathways. She is dressed in a white top and light-colored pants, with a matching cardigan draped over her arms. The background features classical columns, statues, and a distant yellow building under a clear blue sky, suggesting a European city setting.

elnaz/187.jpg.description: A woman in a white bikini and a flowing white skirt stands by the water, gazing upward with her hand near her face. The scene is set against a backdrop of a bright blue sky with scattered clouds and a rocky shoreline. In the distance, buildings are visible along the coast.

elnaz/188.jpg.description: A woman in a flowing white gown stands gracefully in front of an ornate white architectural structure with intricate ironwork. She wears a delicate headpiece and poses with one hand on her hip, while the reflective surface beneath her captures the surrounding greenery and bright sunlight. The scene exudes elegance and a serene, artistic atmosphere.

elnaz/189.jpg.description: A modern architectural structure with a striking blue and beige color scheme, featuring a covered carport illuminated by recessed lighting. Two luxury vehicles, a silver Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon and a sleek black BMW M4, are parked beneath, accentuated by the ambient glow. The scene is set during twilight, with palm fronds framing the top and a manicured lawn adding to the upscale, tropical ambiance.

elnaz/19.jpg.description: A serene tabletop arrangement featuring a bouquet of white flowers in a glass vase, accompanied by luxury beauty products from the brand 'en sulu', including lipsticks and a decorative item. A silver necklace with a pendant lies beside the products, all set against a minimalist background with soft lighting and shadows.

elnaz/190.jpg.description: A person with long hair is seen from behind, joyfully raising their arm while riding in a convertible car along a winding mountain road. The lush green forest surrounds the road, and another vehicle is visible ahead. The sky is partly cloudy, creating a scenic and adventurous atmosphere.

elnaz/191.jpg.description: A pair of white New Balance sneakers with navy blue accents, featuring a mesh upper and thick soles, neatly placed inside their original cardboard box.

She is dressed in a beige cable-knit sweater and matching pants, with black boots. Behind her, an ornate white architectural structure and a large black urn are visible, with the sea and distant cityscape in the background under a partly cloudy sky.

elnaz/291.jpg.description: A couple shares an intimate moment as a large elephant's trunk frames them, creating a heart-shaped composition. The man kisses the woman on the cheek as she smiles, surrounded by lush greenery and a tropical setting.

elnaz/292.jpg.description: A serene camping scene set in a lush green valley at sunrise or sunset, with multiple tents scattered along the banks of a meandering river. A campfire burns gently in the foreground, surrounded by rustic wooden benches. A wooden picnic table is laden with breakfast items including croissants, fruit, and orange juice, inviting relaxation and enjoyment of nature. The landscape is framed by rolling hills and dense trees, creating a peaceful and idyllic outdoor retreat.

elnaz/293.jpg.description: A close-up view of an ornate, classical architectural structure featuring intricately carved columns and detailed stonework under a clear blue sky. The design showcases elaborate carvings, decorative moldings, and a grand archway, evoking a sense of historical grandeur and artistic craftsmanship.

elnaz/294.jpg.description: A person is relaxing in a pool with a stunning view of terraced rice fields surrounded by lush greenery and palm trees. The scene is serene, with other guests also enjoying the pool, and the overcast sky adds to the tranquil atmosphere.

elnaz/295.jpg.description: A woman stands by a railing overlooking water, wearing a brown coat with a dark fur-lined collar. She has a red lanyard around her neck and carries a stylish handbag with a chain strap. Her hair is loosely styled, and she gazes thoughtfully toward the camera with a gentle expression. The background features a calm sea and a distant shoreline, suggesting a coastal or harbor setting.

elnaz/296.jpg.description: A top-down view of a beautifully plated dessert and coffee. A slice of creamy cheesecake is garnished with fresh mint and a dark berry compote, artfully drizzled with red sauce on a white ceramic plate. Beside it, a cup of espresso with intricate latte art sits on a black saucer, both resting on textured placemats over a wooden table.

elnaz/297.jpg.description: A joyful woman is framed by the curved trunk of an elephant, creating a heart-shaped composition. She is smiling warmly, wearing a light-colored top and a delicate necklace, with the elephant's textured skin and natural surroundings forming a serene and memorable moment.

elnaz/298.jpg.description: A serene view from a balcony overlooking lush green terraced rice fields and palm trees, with a cup of coffee on a wooden table in the foreground.

elnaz/299.jpg.description: A person stands inside the open mouth of a massive, moss-covered stone sculpture resembling a giant's face, surrounded by lush greenery and tropical trees. The sculpture features detailed eyes and facial textures, blending seamlessly with the natural environment.

elnaz/3.jpg.description: An open physics textbook page discussing diffraction and polarization of light, with numbered problems and solutions in Kazakh. The page includes a section titled '§23. Жарық дисперсиясы. Жарық поляризациясы' (§23. Light Dispersion. Light Polarization) and features diagrams and text explaining optical phenomena. The page number is 107.

elnaz/30.jpg.description: The Christ the Redeemer statue, a monumental Art Deco sculpture of Jesus Christ, stands majestically atop Corcovado Mountain in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. With arms outstretched, it overlooks the sprawling cityscape and the vast blue waters of Guanabara Bay. The statue is surrounded by lush greenery and offers panoramic views of the urban landscape, including distant hills and beaches. Under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds, the iconic landmark symbolizes peace, compassion, and spiritual guidance, attracting millions of visitors annually.

elnaz/300.jpg.description: Three musicians in white attire and hats play decorated drums in a sunlit plaza, with a large Uruguayan flag prominently displayed on a pole. The setting features cobblestone pavement and surrounding buildings under a clear blue sky.

elnaz/301.jpg.description: An aerial view of a surreal landscape featuring a massive sculpture of two giant hands emerging from the earth, holding a glass-bottomed bridge. Tourists walk along the bridge, which spans across a lush green valley. The sky is painted with warm hues of sunset, and birds fly in formation above. The scene blends natural beauty with monumental art, creating a visually striking and otherworldly experience.

elnaz/302.jpg.description: Two hands hold grilled corn on the cob, with the iconic Hagia Sophia and its surrounding plaza visible in the background under an overcast sky. Palm trees and tourists add to the lively scene.

elnaz/303.jpg.description: A serene balcony overlooks the iconic Eiffel Tower in Paris, with elegant wrought-iron furniture and potted flowers enhancing the romantic ambiance. The scene is bathed in soft sunlight, with a clear sky and distant cityscape completing the picturesque view.

elnaz/304.jpg.description: A breathtaking view of a massive waterfall plunging into a deep canyon, framed by rugged cliffs and lush greenery. Sunlight filters through the mist, casting a golden glow and creating a visible rainbow at the base. The sky above is a mix of soft clouds and warm hues, enhancing the majestic and serene atmosphere of this natural wonder.

elnaz/305.jpg.description: A close-up view of several traditional tea glasses filled with dark red tea, each resting on a white saucer adorned with red and gold decorative patterns. The saucers are placed on an intricately designed tablecloth with floral motifs in red, gold, and dark tones. Small spoons are placed beside the glasses, suggesting a setting for a tea ceremony or a cultural gathering.

elnaz/306.jpg.description: A stunning sunset view of Prague's Old Town Square, featuring the iconic Astronomical Clock on the Old Town Hall and the majestic twin spires of St. Vitus Cathedral in the distance. The cobblestone streets and historic architecture are bathed in warm, golden light, creating a serene and picturesque scene.

elnaz/307.jpg.description: The ancient stone circle of Stonehenge stands majestically under a twilight sky, with a luminous full moon rising above its iconic monoliths. The soft golden light of the setting sun casts long shadows across the lush green grass, highlighting the weathered textures of the stones. Pink and purple hues in the clouds add a serene and mystical atmosphere to this timeless landmark.

elnaz/308.jpg.description: A nighttime view of Prague's Old Town Square, featuring the ornate Astronomical Clock on the Old Town Hall and the illuminated spires of St. Vitus Cathedral in the distance. The cobblestone street reflects the warm glow of streetlights, with a few silhouetted pedestrians adding life to the historic scene.

elnaz/309.jpg.description: A stunning view of St. Basil's Cathedral in Moscow, Russia, with its iconic colorful onion domes and intricate architectural details. The scene is set during twilight, with soft lighting illuminating the cathedral and surrounding buildings. Cars and pedestrians move along the street in front, while the sky above is filled with dramatic clouds, creating a picturesque urban landscape.

elnaz/31.jpg.description: A neatly folded Victoria's Secret robe with pink and white vertical stripes, featuring black trim and brand tags. The garment is displayed on a textured white surface, showcasing its soft fabric and elegant design.

elnaz/310.jpg.description: A breathtaking view of the Golden Bridge, a famous tourist attraction, featuring a massive hand sculpture supporting a winding walkway. Visitors stroll along the bridge as it stretches over a lush, mist-covered valley. The sky is painted with soft hues of sunset, and birds fly overhead, adding to the serene and majestic atmosphere.

elnaz/311.jpg.description: A stunning twilight view of Prague's historic skyline, featuring the iconic St. Vitus Cathedral atop the Prague Castle, with its spires illuminated against a soft, cloudy sky. Below, the Vltava River reflects the warm lights of riverside cafes and traditional European architecture, creating a serene and picturesque scene.

elnaz/312.jpg.description: A modern government building with a glass facade reflecting the blue sky, adorned with a national emblem and flagpole, surrounded by tall evergreen trees under a clear sky.

elnaz/313.jpg.description: A serene seaside patio with a lemon tree laden with fruit, wooden chairs and a table set for two, overlooking the deep blue sea with sailboats in the distance. The scene is framed by a stone building with blue shutters, evoking a Mediterranean coastal charm under a clear sky.

elnaz/314.jpg.description: The image shows the exterior of Atirau International Airport, with its name prominently displayed in Cyrillic and English. The modern building features large glass windows and a metallic facade. Several people are gathered near the entrance, and a dog is resting on the grass in the foreground. The sky is partly cloudy, and tall flagpoles stand in front of the building, with trees adding greenery to the scene.

elnaz/315.jpg.description: A modern urban scene featuring a tall glass building and a construction site with a crane. A large blue sign with Cyrillic text reading 'АТЫРАУ' and 'МУНАИЛЫ АСТАНА • НЕФТЯНАЯ СТОЛИЦА' is prominently displayed on a pedestrian overpass. Bare tree branches frame the right side of the image, and the ground appears to be a mix of pavement and dirt. The overall color tone is cool and blue, suggesting early morning or late afternoon light.

elnaz/316.jpg.description: A grand building with classical architectural elements, featuring a prominent clock tower with a teal-colored spire. The facade combines traditional stonework with modern glass panels that reflect the vibrant, colorful sky. The scene is set during sunset or sunrise, with pastel hues of blue, pink, and orange illuminating the clouds and casting a warm glow on the structure.

elnaz/317.jpg.description: A smiling woman with a yellow flower in her hair sits at a table in a vibrant, tropical-themed cafe. In front of her is a colorful fruit platter featuring pineapple, mango, and granola, with a whole pineapple nearby. The background features purple walls with decorative leaf patterns and the text 'GOOD FOOD' and 'HAPPILY'.

elnaz/318.jpg.description: A black-and-white photograph of a bronze equestrian statue depicting two mounted figures, likely historical or mythological heroes, positioned on a stone pedestal. The statue is set against a backdrop of urban buildings under an overcast sky. The image has a watermark reading 'ATYRAU', suggesting the location. The composition emphasizes the monumentality of the sculpture and its integration into the cityscape.

elnaz/319.jpg.description: A breathtaking view of a serene mountain lake nestled between lush green forests and towering snow-capped peaks under a clear blue sky. Several small boats dot the turquoise waters, adding a touch of human presence to the vast natural landscape.

elnaz/32.jpg.description: The Statue of Liberty stands tall with the American flag waving behind her, set against the backdrop of the New York City skyline. Her iconic green patina contrasts with the vibrant red, white, and blue of the flag, while her reflection shimmers in the water below, capturing a powerful symbol of freedom and national pride.

elnaz/320.jpg.description: A low-angle shot of a red brick building with ornate white trim, featuring arched windows and a golden emblem centered above them. A teal flag flies atop the roof against a partly cloudy sky.

elnaz/321.jpg.description: An aerial view of a modern, curved pedestrian bridge spanning a wide river at sunset. The sky is painted with vibrant orange and pink hues, with clouds illuminated by the setting sun. In the background, a cityscape features tall glass towers and other buildings. The riverbanks are lined with greenery and event banners, suggesting a public gathering or festival. The bridge is adorned with lights and appears to be bustling with people.

elnaz/322.jpg.description: An aerial view of a cityscape in autumn, showcasing a mix of residential buildings, a prominent glass skyscraper, a shopping center with visible signage, and a Ferris wheel nestled among trees with golden foliage. The scene is bathed in warm sunlight, highlighting the vibrant colors of the season and the urban layout.

elnaz/323.jpg.description: A vibrant field of colorful tulips stretches across the landscape, with a classic red and white windmill standing prominently in the background. The tulips display a stunning array of hues including pink, yellow, red, and white, arranged in neat rows. The sky above is partly cloudy with soft sunlight filtering through, creating a picturesque and serene scene typical of a Dutch tulip garden.

elnaz/324.jpg.description: Three scuba divers explore a vibrant coral reef, swimming alongside a large sea turtle. The underwater scene is filled with colorful corals and small fish, with sunlight filtering through the clear blue water. Bubbles rise from the divers' gear, adding to the dynamic and serene marine environment.

elnaz/325.jpg.description: Two massive stone moai statues stand solemnly on a grassy plateau under a vibrant sunset sky, with clouds painted in hues of pink and orange. The statues, carved with distinct facial features, are positioned facing each other, overlooking the ocean in the distance. The scene evokes a sense of ancient mystery and natural beauty.

elnaz/326.jpg.description: A grand architectural archway illuminated at night, flanked by tall buildings with warm lighting. A wide staircase leads toward a striking purple-lit conical structure in the distance, with a solitary figure walking up the steps. The scene is set against a dark sky, creating a dramatic and visually captivating urban nightscape.

elnaz/327.jpg.description: A grand indoor atrium with a large Kazakh flag hanging prominently from the ceiling. The space features symmetrical architecture with multiple levels, walkways, and decorative water features. The design includes greenery, fountains, and colorful banners, creating a spacious and elegant environment.

elnaz/328.jpg.description: A striking night view of the iconic Beijing Tower, illuminated in golden hues against a deep blue sky. The tower's unique spherical top and branching structure stand out prominently, flanked by modern skyscrapers. Below, wet pavement reflects the lights of moving cars, creating a dynamic urban scene with a blend of traditional and contemporary architecture.

elnaz/329.jpg.description: The Irish flag, with its distinctive green, white, and orange vertical stripes, waves proudly in front of a historic stone building featuring Gothic-style windows and architectural details. The overcast sky provides a soft, diffused light, enhancing the rich textures of the stone and the vibrant colors of the flag. Lush greenery and flowering plants in the foreground add a touch of natural beauty to the scene.

elnaz/33.jpg.description: A woman with long brown hair is smiling while standing on a boat, wearing a brown coat with a shearling collar. She is leaning on the railing, looking down with a joyful expression. The background shows a body of water and a distant shoreline with buildings, suggesting a scenic coastal or lakeside location.

elnaz/330.jpg.description: A stunning sunset view over a modern cityscape, featuring a prominent spherical tower with a lattice structure rising above a lush green park. The sky is painted with vibrant hues of pink and orange, contrasting with the sleek glass and concrete architecture. The foreground includes a tall building with reflective windows, while the background reveals a dense urban environment with high-rise buildings and winding roads. The scene captures the harmony between nature and urban development during the golden hour.

elnaz/331.jpg.description: An aerial view of a modern building with a landscaped courtyard featuring winding pathways, greenery, and a swimming pool. People are seen walking and relaxing in the open space, with large windows and banners adorning the building's facade.

elnaz/332.jpg.description: Nazarbayev University, a modern architectural landmark with a prominent dome and illuminated facade, captured during twilight. The building features classical columns and decorative elements, surrounded by landscaped grounds with pathways and lighting fixtures.

elnaz/333.jpg.description: A majestic stone castle perched atop a lush green cliff overlooking the turbulent ocean, with waves crashing against the rocks below. The sky above is dramatic, painted with hues of orange and gray as the sun sets behind the clouds, casting a warm glow over the scene. The rugged coastline and ancient architecture evoke a sense of timeless beauty and solitude.

elnaz/334.jpg.description: An outdoor beach painting setup with two blank canvases on easels, art supplies including brushes and paint tubes, and drinks on a white blanket, with the ocean and a distant rock formation in the background.

elnaz/335.jpg.description: A vibrant and colorful acai bowl served in a wooden bowl, featuring sliced bananas, diced mango, pineapple, granola, and a scoop of acai puree. It is garnished with a fresh mint leaf and accompanied by a side of roasted plantain chips. The setting includes a purple napkin and a whole pineapple nearby, suggesting a tropical or health-focused dining experience.

elnaz/336.jpg.description: A serene tropical beach with crystal-clear turquoise waters gently lapping onto golden sand. Lush green palm trees arch gracefully along the shoreline, their fronds swaying under a bright blue sky dotted with fluffy white clouds. The scene exudes tranquility and natural beauty, perfect for relaxation and escape.

elnaz/337.jpg.description: A stunning view of St. Basil's Cathedral in Moscow, showcasing its iconic colorful onion domes against a dramatic twilight sky. The intricate architectural details and vibrant hues of the cathedral stand out vividly, with the surrounding trees and evening lights adding to the enchanting atmosphere.

elnaz/338.jpg.description: An aerial view of a bustling cityscape at sunset, showcasing a wide avenue flanked by towering skyscrapers and lush green trees. The scene is centered around a circular plaza with a prominent monument, illuminated by the warm glow of the setting sun. The sky is painted with hues of orange and yellow, contrasting with the dark silhouettes of distant mountains. City lights begin to twinkle, indicating the transition from day to night.

elnaz/339.jpg.description: A black and white husky dog stands on a grassy field, wearing a red leash. The dog is viewed from behind, with its ears perked up and its body facing away from the camera. A person's legs and feet are visible nearby, suggesting the dog is being walked or is in a park setting. The grass is green and sunlit, with dappled shadows from nearby trees.

elnaz/34.jpg.description: A breathtaking view of Mount Fuji at sunrise, framed by a traditional red pagoda and blooming cherry blossoms in the foreground. The serene sky transitions from soft blue to gentle orange near the horizon, casting a warm glow over the distant mountain and the cityscape below. The composition highlights the harmony between nature, architecture, and the iconic Japanese landscape.

elnaz/340.jpg.description: A vibrant Jamaican flag waves proudly atop a rocky cliff overlooking the turquoise ocean, with a thatched-roof structure visible in the distance under a partly cloudy sky.

elnaz/341.jpg.description: A scenic view of a tropical beach in Jamaica, featuring a large sign spelling 'JAMAICA' in bold letters with the country's national colors. Palm trees sway gently against a backdrop of turquoise ocean and a partly cloudy sky, evoking a relaxing vacation atmosphere.

elnaz/342.jpg.description: A vibrant street scene in a colorful Mexican town, with a large Mexican flag waving proudly against a clear blue sky. The cobblestone street is flanked by brightly painted colonial-style buildings, and a flowering bougainvillea adds bursts of pink to the scene. Tourists stroll along the sidewalk, enjoying the sunny day and the charming atmosphere.

elnaz/343.jpg.description: Three people and a husky dog are enjoying a sunny day in a park with tall pine trees. One person is holding a red leash attached to the husky, while another person holds a microphone and a phone, suggesting they might be recording or filming. The group appears relaxed and engaged in outdoor leisure.

elnaz/344.jpg.description: A picturesque coastal street at sunset, flanked by white buildings with blue shutters and adorned with flowering plants. Donkeys carrying baskets and cyclists navigate the cobblestone path, leading towards a tranquil harbor with boats and a hillside town in the background.

elnaz/345.jpg.description: A woman sits on a park bench with a husky dog beside her, being interviewed by a man holding a microphone. Another person films the scene with a smartphone. The setting is an open grassy area under a cloudy sky, with trees and distant buildings in the background.

elnaz/346.jpg.description: An overhead view of a bustling indoor event titled 'WOMAN WHO MATTERS 2024', featuring a large crowd of attendees gathered around a red carpet and backdrop. People are dressed in stylish evening wear, many holding phones, suggesting a networking or awards gathering. The venue has large windows revealing a snowy outdoor scene, and the lighting creates a warm, vibrant atmosphere.

elnaz/347.jpg.description: A Kazakh flag, featuring a blue field with a golden sun and soaring steppe eagle, is displayed indoors, hanging from a golden finial against dark curtains. The flag is positioned near a window with blinds and a radiator, with part of a black office chair visible in the foreground.

elnaz/348.jpg.description: An indoor event with an audience seated in rows of pink chairs, watching a presentation. A speaker stands on stage in front of a large screen displaying Russian text. A technician is operating equipment nearby. The setting appears to be a conference or seminar room with modern lighting and wood-paneled walls.

elnaz/349.jpg.description: A woman is presenting data analytics in a modern conference room, pointing to a large screen displaying colorful bar graphs and charts. Several colleagues are seated around a table, attentively watching the presentation, with laptops and notebooks in front of them.

elnaz/35.jpg.description: The image captures the Kaaba, draped in its black cloth with golden embroidery, positioned in the foreground. Behind it rise the towering structures of the Abraj Al-Bait complex, including the prominent clock tower with Arabic inscriptions and illuminated minarets, set against a twilight sky.

elnaz/350.jpg.description: An audience in a red-lit theater is applauding enthusiastically, with many people holding up phones to capture the moment. The venue has tiered seating and a dramatic spotlight illuminating the crowd, creating an atmosphere of excitement and celebration.

elnaz/351.jpg.description: Three business professionals are gathered around a wooden table, analyzing financial data and charts. They are actively engaged in a discussion, pointing at printed reports and using a laptop displaying graphs. The scene conveys a collaborative and analytical work environment, likely in a corporate or financial setting.

elnaz/352.jpg.description: A breathtaking view of a turquoise lake nestled between lush green mountains under a clear blue sky with scattered clouds. Visitors can be seen along a winding path on the lakeshore, enjoying the scenic beauty. The water is dotted with small boats, enhancing the tranquil and picturesque atmosphere.

elnaz/353.jpg.description: A speaker stands on a stage in front of a large audience seated in a modern auditorium, delivering a presentation or speech. The stage is illuminated, and a large screen displays text behind the speaker. The audience appears engaged, with some individuals using their phones. The venue features warm wooden paneling and contemporary lighting design.

elnaz/354.jpg.description: A professional presentation is taking place in a modern conference room. A man in a suit stands near a large screen displaying colorful data visualizations, including charts and graphs, while addressing an audience seated around a table. The room features large windows with blinds and contemporary wooden furniture, creating a bright and corporate atmosphere.

elnaz/355.jpg.description: A group of four business professionals are gathered around a table, enthusiastically high-fiving in a celebratory gesture. They are smiling and appear to be enjoying a moment of success or teamwork in a bright, modern office with large windows in the background. The scene conveys energy, collaboration, and positive workplace dynamics.

elnaz/356.jpg.description: A young person wearing a black cap and glasses smiles while seated at a table with food and drinks in a cozy, wood-paneled setting. They are wearing a white t-shirt with a 'New York' graphic. A QR code card and a teapot are visible on the table, suggesting a café or restaurant environment.

elnaz/357.jpg.description: A young man sits at a table in a restaurant, giving a thumbs-up gesture. In front of him are a meal, a drink with a straw, an open notebook, and printed documents, suggesting he is studying or working while eating. The setting appears to be a casual dining area with blue upholstered seating and a modern ceiling design.

elnaz/358.jpg.description: A young boy with short dark hair is smiling gently at the camera. He is wearing a dark green polo shirt with a white collar and a small logo on the left chest. The background is a gradient of blue and purple, suggesting a studio setting with professional lighting.

elnaz/359.jpg.description: A man in a suit is resting his head on a table, covering his face with his hand, conveying a sense of exhaustion or distress. The black-and-white image captures a moment of emotional or physical fatigue, with a window and blinds visible in the background.

elnaz/36.jpg.description: A breathtaking panoramic view from a hillside vineyard overlooking a coastal city nestled between mountains and the sea. Rows of lush green vines stretch along a dirt path, framed by pine trees in the foreground. The cityscape below features modern buildings and a curved beach, with a ship visible on the turquoise waters. The iconic flat-topped mountain looms in the distance under a clear blue sky.

elnaz/360.jpg.description: A group of six people posing together outdoors, likely at a street festival or celebration. They are dressed casually, with several wearing colorful clothing and accessories, including a rainbow flag motif. The setting appears to be a lively urban area with trees, a sidewalk, and storefronts in the background. The photo is taken from a low angle, possibly using a reflection or mirror, as the image is inverted. The group appears cheerful and engaged in the moment.

elnaz/361.jpg.description: A person wearing a cap and glasses is posing inside a high-rise observation deck, leaning on a decorative golden and marble table. Through the large glass windows, a sprawling cityscape with tall buildings is visible under a bright sky. Another person is seen holding a child in the background, adding to the lively atmosphere of the tourist spot.

elnaz/362.jpg.description: Two individuals stand on a misty forest trail, surrounded by fog that obscures the trees in the background. The person on the left wears a black puffer jacket with a hood and glasses, while the person on the right is dressed in a black jacket and beige pants, with a beanie. Both appear to be on a hiking or outdoor excursion, with the foggy atmosphere creating a serene and mysterious setting.

elnaz/363.jpg.description: A breathtaking view of a tropical coastline with turquoise waters, sandy beaches, and lush green cliffs. Palm trees dot the shoreline, and dramatic rock formations rise from the sea. The scene is bathed in bright sunlight under a clear blue sky, suggesting a serene and picturesque vacation spot.

elnaz/364.jpg.description: Four friends posing together on a soccer field at night, standing in front of a netted fence with stadium lights illuminating the scene. They are dressed in athletic wear, including jackets and soccer cleats, suggesting they've just finished playing or are about to play. The atmosphere is casual and friendly, with smiles and camaraderie evident.

elnaz/365.jpg.description: Two individuals pose for a photo at a tech or conference event. The person on the left, wearing a cap and glasses, points to their badge. The person on the right, with a beard and a striped shirt, also points to his badge, which identifies him as a speaker. The background features vibrant blue and purple lighting with abstract digital designs, suggesting a modern, high-tech setting.

elnaz/366.png.description: Two people are standing on a misty forest trail, surrounded by fog that obscures the trees in the background. The person on the left wears a black puffer vest and a cap, while the person on the right is dressed in a dark jacket and a beanie. Both appear to be enjoying a hike in a cool, damp environment.

elnaz/367.jpg.description: A white frosted cake in a cardboard box, decorated with a cartoon character wearing a red party hat and holding a small cake with the number 17. The cake is adorned with red hearts and has Russian text that reads 'Без паники ты не старенький' (Without panic, you're not old).

elnaz/368.jpg.description: A close-up of a plated meal featuring two seared meat patties garnished with fresh herbs and accompanied by golden, crispy potato wedges. The dish is served on a speckled ceramic plate, with a small bowl of sauce and cutlery nearby. In the background, another plate with sushi rolls and a beverage are visible, suggesting a restaurant setting.

elnaz/369.jpg.description: A flat-lay arrangement of luxury makeup products from brands like Dior, Givenchy, and Charlotte Tilbury, displayed on a textured gray surface. The collection includes an eyeshadow palette, a compact powder, a lip gloss, a makeup brush set, and a Dior gift bag with ribbon, all arranged to showcase their elegant packaging and design.

elnaz/37.jpg.description: A historic European city square featuring ornate buildings with classical architecture, a prominent flagpole displaying Romanian flags, and a cobblestone plaza with benches and decorative chains. The scene is set under a partly cloudy sky, with cars parked along the street and pedestrians visible in the distance.

elnaz/370.jpg.description: A selfie featuring a young person with glasses and a woman with styled hair, both smiling at the camera. The woman is wearing a polka-dotted dress and holding a water bottle, while the young person is in a white t-shirt with a black strap over their shoulder. They appear to be at an outdoor event with people and chairs in the background.

elnaz/371.jpg.description: A white Dior gift bag with a gold logo and a white ribbon bow sits on a textured gray surface, illuminated by a focused beam of sunlight that casts dramatic shadows around it.

elnaz/372.jpg.description: A large black banner advertising 'Новогодние Елки' (New Year Trees) is displayed on the facade of a building. The banner features an image of decorated Christmas trees with lights and includes contact information. Below the banner, a green utility vehicle and a motorcycle are parked in front of the building, with two people standing nearby. The sky above is clear and blue with scattered clouds.

elnaz/373.jpg.description: A breathtaking view of a secluded beach framed by lush green cliffs and a winding staircase leading down to the shore. The ocean stretches to the horizon under a soft pastel sky, suggesting either sunrise or sunset. The scene is serene, with the natural beauty of the coastline and the inviting path creating a sense of peaceful exploration.

elnaz/374.png.description: Five individuals pose for a photo in front of a branded backdrop featuring logos such as 'Everest Development', 'Chivas Regal', and 'MM Group'. The group includes three women and two men, dressed in casual to semi-formal attire. One woman holds a patterned handbag, another wears a lanyard with a badge, and the man on the right gestures toward the camera while holding a jacket. The backdrop is black with white text and orange accents.

elnaz/375.jpg.description: A hand with a delicate ring gently holds a lush bouquet of pink roses wrapped in light green paper, with eucalyptus sprigs adding a touch of greenery. The scene exudes romance and elegance, suggesting a special occasion or celebration.

elnaz/376.jpg.description: Four individuals, likely event staff or participants, are gathered around a wooden table in a modern, industrial-style interior. They are all wearing matching black t-shirts with a logo and blue lanyards with badges. One person is taking a selfie with a phone, another is looking at a phone, and the others are engaged in conversation or observing. The setting includes exposed concrete walls, hanging lights, and large windows with curtains. The atmosphere appears casual and collaborative.

elnaz/377.png.description: A close-up of a person wearing a light purple shoulder bag with a zipper closure and a decorative metal clasp. The bag is slung over their shoulder, and they are dressed in a colorful, patterned top with green, pink, and white hues. The image focuses on the bag and the upper torso of the person, with a blurred background suggesting an outdoor setting.

elnaz/378.jpg.description: A person wearing a beige cap and casual attire is speaking into a microphone while gesturing with their hand raised, standing in front of a large screen displaying the 'Vivib' logo. The setting appears to be a modern event space with wooden paneling and contemporary lighting fixtures.

elnaz/379.jpg.description: A person wearing a cap and glasses is seated at a table in a high-rise observation deck, gently touching a golden block displayed on a reflective pedestal. The expansive curved windows behind them offer a panoramic view of a sprawling cityscape bathed in warm, golden sunlight.

elnaz/38.jpg.description: The Kaaba, draped in its black cloth with golden embroidery, stands prominently in the foreground, surrounded by pilgrims in white garments. Behind it, the towering structure of the Abraj Al-Bait complex rises against a clear blue sky, featuring a clock tower with a crescent and star emblem at its peak. The scene captures the grandeur and spiritual significance of the Hajj pilgrimage in Mecca.

elnaz/380.jpg.description: A boxing ring with blue posts and white ropes is set up in a large indoor arena, surrounded by empty spectator seats and stage lighting equipment. A blue ladder leans against the ring, and a cameraman is visible on the right side. The venue appears to be prepared for an event, with black stage coverings and spotlights illuminating the area.
